title: Formalisme algébrique des correspondances et algèbres de Poincaré-Hodge (cf conjectures standard) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), lettres (1966-1967).

deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics by Grothendieck. It is page 45 of a typed bibliography, references [14]–[27], from some other typescript, likely reused as scratch paper (recto or verso) for his handwritten notes on Poincaré–Hodge algebras. Those notes are on the neighbouring pages: data (V, χ, W̃, Q̃, α, ξ) modelling the cup-product structure of H^1 and H^2 under the standard conjectures.

The references concern Galois and flat cohomology over local and function fields:
- [14] Grothendieck, Tohoku (the ditto line points back to [13], presumably also Grothendieck).
- [15], [16], [19] Hochschild, Hochschild–Nakayama and Nakayama on class field theory cohomology.
- [17] Hochschild–Serre spectral sequence.
- [18] Lang, Abelian Varieties.
- [20] Ogg, cohomology of abelian varieties over function fields.
- [21] Rosenberg–Zelinsky, Amitsur complex.
- [22]–[25] Serre: Corps Locaux, Cohomologie galoisienne notes ('Dimension cohomologique'), Groupes algébriques et corps de classes, the Mexico City Witt-vector cohomology paper.
- [26] Shatz, 'Cohomology of artinian group schemes over local fields', listed as 'to appear' in Ann. of Math.
- [27] Tate duality for abelian varieties over p-adic fields (Lang's notes).

Shatz's paper appeared in Ann. of Math. 79 (1964), so the typescript dates from about 1963–64. It is plausibly a paper or thesis in Shatz's circle on flat or Grothendieck-topology cohomology of group schemes over local fields; the exact source is unsure. Handwritten '27' is the archive folio number. No mathematical argument is present.
